## Overview

QIRT 2026 (18th International Conference on Quantitative InfraRed Thermography) is scheduled for 29 June to 3 July 2026 in Naples (Italy). The conference scope covers quantitative infrared thermography methods, including calibration, measurement approaches, uncertainty, and quantitative interpretation of infrared data.
